scope: Source-level diagnosis and existing archived control review only. This report is not a runtime acceptance or a writer attribution.

conclusion.summary: The active Mikka path has no identified direct write to either rejected path. Fixed upstream source supplies plausible natural writers, but the actual R7 provider/APT identities and exact failure phases remain unknown. No finalization rule should be expanded from source resemblance, another template kind, or an absent-baseline control.

runCmds.action: Require /opt/mikka absent, then create the private root.
Capture original filesystem entries and CLI manifest.
Run the copied official-e2b-instance-bootstrap.sh at the fixed source and worker identity.
Check private npm by executing a generated scratch-only test script.
Strict original-files verification, with no E2B-finalization policy.

laterGates.action: Start prebuilt worker, verify anonymous ready state and no identity; Desktop also verifies unauthenticated viewer=401; then verify with the exact kind's finalization policy.
Read and validate the completed anonymous preload receipt; the current release probe does not invoke a second model catalogue exchange.
Read strict/install and ready receipts, validate them, run fresh original-files scan with the finalization policy, then kill the disposable sandbox.

activeSourcePath.phaseBoundary: A ready-stage refusal and fresh_scan refusal have different sources. The newest public report contains neither phase. Source ordering alone does not prove which latest gate failed.
activeSourcePath.diagnosticBoundary: official-files.py:298-319 emits only changed fields in before/after; fields absent from that diagnostic are unknown. No complete row is reconstructed from an older template.
activeSourcePath.strictRule: Do not turn an installation-stage mismatch into a permitted finalization change. Full original-file installation conservation remains exact.

legacyBootstrap.reason: Not copied or called by this builder. Their apt invocations are not an identified writer in the actual active path.

installTransitives.privateProjection: prepare-worker-install.py preserves only packageManager/engines/pnpm from the root manifest, creates an empty root importer, and limits workspace importers to daemon/protocol/config. The actual root package has no pnpm key.

staticClosure.algorithm: Traverse importer name/version references and snapshot dependencies+optionalDependencies, equivalent to build-template.py lock_projection helpers.

esbuild.observedWrites: Package-local binary/wrapper files; fallback nested npm install runs in a package-local npm-install directory; direct binary fallback chmods that binary 0755.

harnessInstaller.operation: Download the pinned integrity-checked platform archive, extract into private staging, create private links and marker, rename into /opt/mikka/harness. It does not run npm lifecycle scripts.

desktop.operation: pip install --target /opt/mikka/computer aiohttp==3.13.3, private cache/HOME, copy desktop scripts/defaults, extract a verified Cua archive into the private computer directory.
desktop.limitation: No --only-binary or transitive lock is present. Source-only review cannot replace the actual install receipt or claim every selected pip artifact/hook was inspected.

installTransitives.directWriteConclusion: No direct CA-root or apt-backup writer found in the active installer or inspected allowed hook source. This is a bounded source finding, not proof that all third-party binaries or background jobs made no writes.

startup.prebuilt: start-prebuilt.sh creates the private viewer runtime directory and starts viewer-gateway.py as root for Desktop, then runuser -u user starts cloud-worker --wait-bootstrap.
startup.modelPreload: cloud-bootstrap.ts calls probeHostedRuntimeModels; model-probe.ts creates disposable scratch HOME/config directories and exchanges initialize/model-list messages with installed CLIs, then drains/kills children and deletes scratch.
startup.anonymousSpareBoundary: startAnonymousCodex/Claude are inside accept(), after consuming a real bootstrap hint. They are not the pre-bootstrap preload path checked by the builder.
startup.desktopGateway: At idle startup its own direct writes are /run/mikka-viewer/guard-protocol and viewer counters. start-desktop.sh and the Cua lease driver are not invoked by start-prebuilt's idle gateway.
startup.caveat: Installed CLI and dependency native-binary behavior was not dynamically audited. No rootCA uid/gid is inferred for the newest R7 from its publicly reported mode alone.

sourceFacts: packages/envd/internal/host/cacerts.go:28 names the exact CA path; :123 starts asynchronous work; :136-138 makes its directory 0755 and writes the CA with creation mode 0644.
The same recursive /usr/local chmod remains in the separately read c7cd359318b0d835e1d0ffad02d755dd62f7a1da source.
upstreamMechanisms.inference: If the provider has created that original CA before its recursive chmod executes, those source operations can naturally produce the reported mode transition.
upstreamMechanisms.forbiddenInference: The fixed source is not proof that this R7 deployed either revision, nor that every Codex template will reproduce the transition.

sourceFacts: Debian/apt debian/apt.systemd.daily:338-347 compares backup .0 against /var/lib/apt/extended_states, copies live state and rotates it with savelog when different.
The backup block precedes the APT::Periodic::Enable check at :356.
The adjacent apt-daily.service starts apt.systemd.daily update; apt-daily.timer is persistent with randomized scheduling.
upstreamMechanisms.inference: A naturally scheduled APT maintenance job is a concrete possible backup writer, including when the live state was already different before the sampled interval.
upstreamMechanisms.forbiddenInference: Do not equate this source revision with the deployed Desktop, infer a package change from backup-only SHA change, or invoke maintenance to force reproduction.

priorCodexReview.scope: Older 111a run42621280244 had owner-reported Codex ready mode refusal after strict installation passed. That older phase and row gaps must not be copied into the latest 5ba R7.

nextEvidence.ownerCoordination: Root reports #1505 owner has taken the unique finite Codex/Desktop official control at PR1834 comment6747040287. Reuse that owner's existing originals; no parallel control is authorized or started by this reviewer.
nextEvidence.first: Use the designated original reader's safe Git projection for latest exact phase and already-available bounded diffs. Preserve unavailable complete stat rows as unknown.

codex.observation: Record natural presence/absence, lstat fields, hash and fixed reference chains; absence is a valid observed result but does not cover an existing-original-file mode transition.

desktop.observation: Record the paired kind/mode/uid/gid/size/hash and stable file identity before/after hashing; use no-follow opens. Compare whether changed backup hash matches the live hash at that phase; retain races/absence as such.
desktop.optionalIdentity: Read-only actual apt script/unit hashes and version can distinguish source resemblance from deployment identity; missing identity remains unknown.

restrictions: No chmod or CA creation to manufacture a baseline.
No writing backup/live files, apt/savelog execution, timer changes, or restoring system state.
No repeated runs or added waits solely to obtain the preferred result.
No broad /usr/local or /var/backups exclusion; no cross-template mode rule transfer.
Observation complete does not mean transition reproduced or release accepted.
nextEvidence.ifUnreproduced: Retain the rejection. Use phase-bound diagnostic gaps from the actual run to choose any further minimal investigation; do not relabel a negative control as evidence for a policy exception.
